declared_at: 2026-10-06, BEFORE any backtest/forward result was computed; not tuned afterwards
frequency: monthly total returns: Yahoo adjclose, last observed level per calendar month (engine align_levels freq='M'); partial month 2026-10 dropped; last complete month 2026-09
covariance: 36-month trailing SAMPLE covariance of MONTHLY returns (window=36, min_periods=36), annualised x12
rebalance: monthly, at the month-end close of the estimation month; weights earn from the next month
financing: cash leg earns FRED DTB3 (actual/360, rate known at prior month-end); borrowed fraction pays DTB3 + 50 bp
universe: PCRIX commodities (chosen over DBC: longer history so GLD is the binding start)
common_window: first monthly return 2004-12 (GLD lists 2004-11-18) to 2026-09; walk-forward trading from 2007-11 month-end after 36m warm-up

quadrant_mapping.basis: engine CANONICAL_MAP; VWESX (long-duration IG, mostly rate risk) mapped as nominal bond; REITs as equity; HY as credit

same_risk_as_stocks: ERC geared each month to the trailing 36m vol of VFINX (cap 3x)
stress_rule: stress month = VFINX month-end total-return level more than 10% below its running peak (expanding max of month-end levels since 1980)
long_run: VFINX, VFITX, VUSTX from 1991-11; strategies VFINX B&H, 60/40 VFINX/VFITX, ERC(VFINX,VFITX) geared to 10%; rolling 36m stock-bond correlations
forward: stationary block bootstrap (Politis-Romano), mean block 12 months, 10y horizon, 10,000 paths, seed 20261006, constant-mix monthly; history = common-window monthly returns joined with DTB3 cash return (bootstrapped jointly); weights = full-sample-covariance ERC / quadrant geared to 10% ex-ante (cap 3x); 50 bp spread on borrowing; no costs
corr_stress: history re-coloured to the correlation C_s = 0.5 C_full + 0.5 C_2022 (vols and means kept; C_2022 = daily-return correlation over calendar 2022), weights NOT re-geared
live_sanity: geared quadrant (6) monthly returns vs ALLW (from 2025-04) and RPAR (from 2020-01) on overlapping months
